row: My name is Kelsie Emerson, EMFT, CEMT. I’m a Certified Equine Massage Therapist, Certified Equine Myo-Manipulative Functional Therapist, Professional Member of the IAAMB, Professional Member of the ABMP, and have 25+ years of horse experience in multiple disciplines. I use a combination of equine sports massage, Swedish massage, and myofascial release techniques + core exercises to keep horses moving and feeling their best!
